agentUpdateInstructions: Update from v0.4.9 to v0.4.10 without resetting. Back up D1, R2, Durable Object state and private settings. Install frozen dependencies with Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4 and @runeditrun/rer 0.2.68. This patch changes only a test fixture credential and release metadata. No new migrations: the current 95-row ledger must plan nothing and refuse nothing. Never delete, reorder or edit ledger rows. Retain owners, imported support history, permissions, files and erasure fences. The seven mailbox settings remain optional and held secrets are inherited. Run rer deploy --dry-run against the retained installation before deployment. Upgrades from v0.4.7 still apply the seven missing v0.4.8 migrations by name. Retain human Send. Production deployment is separate.
publicReleaseNotes: HappyToHelp v0.4.10 renames the cron-backlog test signing token and its matching inbound request to an explicitly synthetic value. RER's hosted credential scanner can accept the public source before agent dispatch. Existing assertions retain the same behavior; application behavior is unchanged. No new migrations; rer stays at 0.2.68. Back up and retain settings and migration history without resetting. Production deployment is separate.

pendingMigrations.buyerSteps: R9a company records, typed attributes, membership, domains and reversible merge history. Apply through pinned rer before the updated Worker serves traffic; retain existing records and private settings without resetting.

R9a import-local concurrency fences replace the global customer counter. Apply through pinned rer before the updated Worker serves traffic; existing previews retain their stale-change protection without changing unrelated import undo state.

R9a restores preserve the resolution trigger with CASE boundary whitespace compatible with the pinned Wrangler SQL splitter. Apply through pinned rer; trigger behavior and all existing records stay unchanged.
